posts.title: Sitting on something
posts.description: I find that I almost never regret sitting on something. If something happens, it’s worth resisting the urge to text someone about it right away, or look up something about it online. After letting it sit awhile, it often becomes obvious it was molehill and easy to forget and move on.

posts.title: What isn’t earned isn’t valued
posts.description: I’ve spent the last week in Arizona. When I was packing I almost forgot to bring along my Arizona driver’s license, which was unceremoniously cast to the bottom of a drawer. I can’t help but feel something like disgust when looking at it. I got the thing when I was 16 by driving a few blocks and parallel parking between cones three times wider than any spot I’ve seen in Amsterdam.

posts.title: Llama Llama
posts.description: The first time I heard a Llama Llama book being read was my wife reading the Ukrainian version to our daughter. Ukrainian is a very melodic language and sounds lovely in verse, which is why I just assumed the book was originally written in Ukrainian.
